entries: From Ottoman Turkish شریعت (şeri'at), from Arabic شَرِيعَة (šarīʕa).

West Central German form of the name Anton or Antonius. Compare the traditional Colognian humorous characters Tünnes un Schäl, where, however, Tünnes is a quirky, but not a ridiculous or stupid person.
senses: tomfool, a male person who is (for whatever reason) ridiculous, not to be taken seriously
a male person who is clumsy or forgetful (less negative than sense 1)
